The "surgery_type" is laparoscopic radical resection for colorectal cancer, as mentioned in the Introduction and Methods sections.

Next, I need to check the details about laparoscopy in both groups. Since all patients underwent laparoscopic surgery, both groups have 100% laparoscopy. However, the article doesn't provide exact counts but mentions it's laparoscopic, so I'll note it as "all procedures" for both groups.

Regarding vasoactive drug use, the control group used phenylephrine more than the PPV group (24 vs. 12 patients). Norepinephrine use was 24 in control vs. 15 in PPV, though the difference wasn't statistically significant.

Looking at morbidity, the PPV group had 19 patients with complications, while the control had 32. Mortality wasn't mentioned, so I'll mark that as NR. Hospital LOS was 11.0 days for PPV and 13.0 days for control.

Recovery times: PPV group had a shorter time to defecation (58.5 h vs. 73.5 h) and shorter LOS. Other recovery metrics like flatus, oral intake, and ambulation times weren't significantly different, so they'll be marked as NR.

Postoperative ileus is mentioned under gastrointestinal dysfunction, with 11 cases in PPV and 22 in control.

I need to ensure all fields are correctly mapped, especially noting where each value was sourced from (e.g., Results, Table 2). I'll avoid any prior knowledge and strictly use the article's data, ensuring units and decimal places are preserved as per the article.
